count verb

also counting, numbers, count up, count out, you don’t count

classical

Traupman 297

numerō, numerāre, numerāvī, numerātum

verb, first conjugation

Other words

  • ēnumerō, ēnumerāre, ēnumerāvī, ēnumerātum — count up, count out

    verb, first conjugation · also used · classical · Ter. Ad. 2.2.28: jamne ēnumerāstī id, quod ad tē reditūrum putēs? (Lewis & Short); Traupman 297

Examples

  • Jussus numerāre, sex numerāvit.

    Told to count, he counted six.composed

  • Extrā numerum es mihi.

    You don’t count (with me).Traupman 297

See also one, once, countless.

SourcesLewis & Short: enumero

Lewis & Short: numero

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 297.
